about_the_game:
Welcome to a place that feels familiar… but isn’t.

In Backrooms: The Familiar Place, you won’t just walk through endless corridors: each level is a unique challenge, with clear objectives, instructions at the start, and mechanics that will test your wits and nerves.

This isn’t the usual “walking simulator.” Each level includes puzzles, item and key hunting, and mechanics that go beyond mere survival.

Constant evolution: I will listen to the community and their ideas to add new levels, entities, and experiences. You are part of the development.

Unpredictable entities: some stalk you from a distance, others wait silently. You can’t always run… sometimes you’ll have to think.

Immersive atmosphere: ambient sounds, flickering lights, and a design that reinforces the feeling of being trapped in a place that is familiar… yet unsettling.

Mysterious instructions: at the start of each level, you will receive guidance… but you’ll never know if it’s meant to help you or lead you to your doom.

Will you be able to find the exit, or will you become lost forever in the familiar?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-8100 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti / AMD RX 560 (4 GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Stable internet connection for multiplayer
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-11400F / AMD Ryzen 5 5600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA RTX 3060 / AMD RX 6600 o superior
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible sound card
  • Additional Notes: Fiber / stable connection for lobbies

short_description: You wake up in a place that shouldn’t exist: endless corridors, flickering lights, and a hum that never stops. At the start of each level, you receive instructions from an unknown source. Who is sending them? What do they want from you?
supported_languages:
English*, Spanish - Latin America
*languages with full audio support
